source.title: Some open problems and recent results in topological algebras.

needs_review.question_text_raw: In [Rend. Semin. Mat. Fis., Milano 59, 49-58 (1989; Zbl 0755.46019)] we posed several new questions and recalled some old ones concerning topological algebras. In this paper, we give a report on the present situation concerning these problems.

evidence.quote: In [Rend. Semin. Mat. Fis., Milano 59, 49-58 (1989; Zbl 0755.46019)] we posed several new questions and recalled some old ones concerning topological algebras. In this paper, we give a report on the present situation concerning these problems. Some of them are already solved, and it turns out that some of them were already solved during the preparation of [loc. cit.] but the author was not aware of this fact.
